title: SQL AG chaos: kill a secondary -> resync
description: The nexus-cli chaos verb for the Always On AG: hard-kill sqlservr on a secondary replica; the replica disconnects; SCM auto-restarts it; the AG reconnects + resyncs.

observe.what: the secondary disconnects during the kill window, then Recovered=true once it reconnects + resyncs

whatProves: an AG secondary tolerates a process kill: the service auto-restarts and the replica resyncs from the primary without operator action.
